model_status: Locally authored Blender mesh, four stone sculptures, arachnid rig and six keyed attacks. Source: Tools/Assets/build_smiling_spider.py.

attacks.name: Fang rush
attacks.hint: Move sideways when it lowers its head.
attacks.motion: Lower head and tuck front legs; charge straight; fangs snap; legs brace.

attacks.name: Reaping sweep
attacks.hint: Crouch under the raised leg or back away.
attacks.motion: Raise right foreleg high; sweep across the front; plant the foot again.

attacks.name: Double bite
attacks.hint: Two snaps. Keep back until both finish.
attacks.motion: Spread both pedipalps; two distinct fang closures with a recoil between.

attacks.name: Silk spit
attacks.hint: Sidestep the silk. Contact slows you briefly.
attacks.motion: Abdomen contracts; head tips back; jaws open and propel one visible silk bolt.

attacks.name: Ground slam
attacks.hint: Jump over the ground pulse or leave its reach.
attacks.motion: Raise both forelegs and body; strike the floor; recoil and recover.

attacks.name: Marked leap
attacks.hint: Leave the marked landing spot. It cannot retarget in flight.
attacks.motion: Crouch with folded legs; spring; tuck legs in flight; land and spread them.
